info.name: updateAnonymizeAfterDate - Update anonymization date for orders

items.docs:
Description
Updates the anonymization date for orders in the Mirakl Connect platform. Use this API to indicated after which date orders should be anonymized by Connect. The anonymization process is irreversible and should be used with caution.
Call Frequency
Recommended usage: Once per order when the anonymization date is set

params.description: Code of the fulfillment center

params.name: order_tax_mode
params.description:
Please note: If the taxes are not specified, the prices with mode TAX_EXCLUDED and with mode TAX_INCLUDED will return the same amounts.
Possible values:
  • TAX_EXCLUDED: the price fields (price, unit price, shipping price, cancellation amount, refund amount and order total prices) do not include taxes.
  • TAX_INCLUDED: the price fields include the tax amount.
  • If this query parameter is not specified, the default order tax mode of the platform is used.

params.name: commissionable
params.description: If true returns only orders with commission, if false returns orders without commission. Please note that this filter is available only when the platform is in mixed commission model

params.name: waiting_tax_confirmation
params.description: If true returns only orders awaiting a tax confirmation, When false it does not impact the result.

params.name: tax_recalculation_required_only
params.description: If true returns only orders for which taxes must be recalculated on at least one order line. When false it does not impact the result. Must be used with at least one date range filter: created or last updated date, of a maximum duration of one month.

params.name: waiting_funding_confirmation
params.description: If true returns only orders awaiting a funding update. When false it does not impact the result.

params.name: refund_state_codes
params.description:
A comma-separated list of refund state's codes.
Must be used in combination with filters start_update_date and end_update_date, with a maximum of one month period.

items.docs:

info.name: OR04 - Patch update orders

items.docs:
Description

Update orders information field by field: unspecified fields will not be updated. To remove the value for a field, send it with the 'null' value (not allowed for the required fields).

You cannot use API OR04 to update customer-related information if the customer has been anonymized via API AN01.

A maximum of 100 orders can be sent at once.

info.name: OR13 - Export orders asynchronously

items.docs:
Description

The API returns a tracking id to be used to query API OR14.
Mirakl recommends to use API OR13 instead of API OR11 as it can handle very large volumes of data.
You must give at least one date range filter: created, last updated date or refunds created date.
API OR13 supports the chunk of the export file into multiple files in order to:

  • respect a maximum megabyte weight using the megabytes_per_chunk parameter

info.name: OR14 - Get the status of an asynchronous order export.

params.name: tracking_id
params.description: Id of the previously created asynchronous order export

items.docs:
Description

Use this API to query the order export status after an API OR13 call.
Until the export via API OR13 is complete, the status returned by API OR14 is PENDING.
You must call API OR14 until you get the COMPLETED status which correspond to a completed and successful export from API OR13.
The URLs in API OR14 response contain all the files from API OR13 export.
Browse those urls and query them using the GE

Maximum usage: Once per file URL returned by OR14, after COMPLETED status

info.name: OR74 - Upload documents to attach to an order

params.name: order_id
params.description: The identifier of the order

items.docs:
Description

Documents filenames must be distinct. Only documents of the following types are supported: csv, doc, xls, xlsx, ppt, pdf, odt, ods, odp, txt, rtf, png, jpg, gif, zpl, mov, mp4.
An order can have a maximum of 50 documents. In the API output we include only documents with errors. All other documents are successfully uploaded.
